## Analysis

Softaware:
R version: 3.2.4 (2016-03-10)
MCMCglmm: V 2.22.1

Platform: x86_64-apple-darwin13.4.0 (64-bit)
Running under: OS X 10.11.4 (El Capitan)

```{r}
library("MCMCglmm")


system.time(
  data.news <- as.data.frame(read.csv("location_on_your_drive\data.news.csv",
                                     header=TRUE,
                                     sep=",")



     


##############################################################################
####  Multiple Imputation models   ####
##############################################################################

## Eliminate columns that will not be imputed
library(dplyr)
js.amelia <-data.news%>%
   select(-c(Id,
             Census.Religion.L3.T5,
             Census.Religion.L2.T5,
             Census.Religion.L1.T5,
             Territorial.Authority.2013.T5,
             Regional.Council.2013.T5,
             T5.ETH.Warm.Arabs,
             T5.ETH.Warm.Muslims,
             T5.ETH.Warm.Asians,
             T5.ETH.Anger.Arabs,
             T5.ETH.Anger.Muslims,
             T5.ETH.Anger.Asians,
             Hours.News.T5))

   

library(Amelia)

js.am.news<-amelia(js.amelia,
              m = 5,
              noms = c("Urban.T5",
                       "Euro.AnyTimePoint", 
                       "Partner.T5",
                       "Gender.T5",
                       "Employed.T5",
                       "Parent.T5",
                       "Born.NZ.T5",
                       "Believe.Spirit.T5",
                       "Believe.God.T5",
                       "EthL2.Maori.T5",
                       "EthL2.Other.T5",
                       "Rel.EthPartL2.Asian.T5",
                       "Rel.EthPartL2.Euro.T5",
                       "EthL3.Samoan.T5",
                       "T5.GENDER.IDENTITY"),
              ords = c("NZREG.T5"),
              idvars=c("Id",
              "Gender",
              "Regional.Council.2013.T5",
              "Territorial.Authority.2013.T5",
              "Census.Religion.L3.T5",
              "Census.Religion.L2.T5",
              "Census.Religion.L1.T5",
              "T5.ETH.Warm.Arabs",
              "T5.ETH.Warm.Immigrants",
              "T5.ETH.Warm.Muslims",
              "T5.ETH.Anger.Arabs",
              "T5.ETH.Anger.Immigrants",
              "T5.ETH.Anger.Muslims"),
              sqrts = c("Hours.Work.T5",
              "Hours.Children.T5",
              "Hours.Charity.T5",
              "Hours.News.T5",
              "Hours.MaoriFRD.T5",
              "Hours.PacificFRD.T5", 
              "Hours.AsiansFRD.T5", 
              "Hours.Commute.T5",
              "Hours.NZEuroOTH.T5",
              "Hours.MaoriOTH.T5",
              "Hours.PacificOTH.T5", 
              "Hours.AsiansOTH.T5",
              "Hours.NZEuroFRD.T5"),
              logs =c("CharityDonate.T5",
              "Household.INC.T5",
              "Religion.Church.T5"))


# Check missing data
missmap(js.am.news)


# Center and Scale varaibles
js.am.news.sc <- transform.amelia(js.am.news,
                              T5.RWA.S = scale(T5.RWA),
                              T5.SDO.S = scale(T5.SDO),
                              Age.T5.C = scale(Age.T5, center=TRUE, scale =FALSE),
                              Pol.Orient.T5.S = scale(Pol.Orient.T5,center=TRUE, scale =TRUE),
                              NZDep_2013.T05.S = scale(NZDep_2013.T05),
                              RELID.T5.S = scale(RELID.T5,center=TRUE, scale =TRUE),
                              Hours.News.T5.S = scale(Hours.News.T5, center=TRUE, scale =TRUE),
                              Territorial.Authority.2013.T5 = factor(Territorial.Authority.2013.T5),
                              Hours.News.T5.SQRT = sqrt(Hours.News.T5),
                              Hours.News.T5.LOG = log(Hours.News.T5+1),
                              Census.Religion.L3.T5 = factor(Census.Religion.L3.T5),
                              NZREG.T5 = as.numeric(NZREG.T5),
                              Hours.News.T5.S=scale(Hours.News.T5))

js.am.news.sc <- transform.amelia(js.am.news.sc,
                              NZREG.T5.S = scale(NZREG.T5))



## Bayesian models
library(MCMCglmm)

# Same parameter expanded prior

prior.1= list(R = list(V = diag(3)*.002, nu=3.01),
                 G=list(G1=list(V=diag(3)*.02,nu=4, alpha.mu = rep(0,3), alpha.V = diag(3)*100),
                        G2=list(V=diag(3)*.02,nu=4, alpha.mu = rep(0,3), alpha.V = diag(3)*100)))




m <- 5  
news.wrm.m.mcmc.out <- NULL
for(i in 1:m) {
news.w.mcmc.out[[i]] <-MCMCglmm(cbind(T5.ETH.Warm.Arabs,T5.ETH.Warm.Asians,T5.ETH.Warm.Muslims) ~
                                   trait-1 +
                                   trait:Hours.News.T5.S *
                                   trait:Pol.Orient.T5.S +
                                   trait:RELID.T5.S +  
                                   trait:Age.T5.C + 
                                   trait:NZREG.T5.S  + 
                                   trait:Employed.T5 +
                                   trait:Euro.AnyTimePoint +
                                   trait:Gender.T5 + 
                                   trait:NZDep_2013.T05.S +
                                   trait:Parent.T5 +
                                   trait:Partner.T5 + 
                                   trait:Urban.T5,
                                 random= ~us(trait):Census.Religion.L3.T5 + us(trait):Territorial.Authority.2013.T5,
                                 rcov = ~us(trait):units, #
                                 family= c("gaussian", "gaussian","gaussian"),
                                 prior =prior.1,
                                 verbose=TRUE, 
                                 nitt=103000,
                                 pr=TRUE,
                                 pl=TRUE,
                                 data=js.am.news.sc$imputations[[i]])
}




m <- 5  
news.ang.m.mcmc.out <- NULL
for(i in 1:m) {
news.ang.m.mcmc.out[[i]] <-MCMCglmm(cbind(T5.ETH.Anger.Arabs,T5.ETH.Anger.Asians,T5.ETH.Anger.Muslims) ~
                                   trait-1 +
                                   trait:Hours.News.T5.S *
                                   trait:Pol.Orient.T5.S +
                                   trait:RELID.T5.S +  
                                   trait:Age.T5.C + 
                                   trait:NZREG.T5.S  + 
                                   trait:Employed.T5 +
                                   trait:Euro.AnyTimePoint +
                                   trait:Gender.T5 + 
                                   trait:NZDep_2013.T05.S +
                                   trait:Parent.T5 +
                                   trait:Partner.T5 + 
                                   trait:Urban.T5,
                                 random= ~us(trait):Census.Religion.L3.T5 + us(trait):Territorial.Authority.2013.T5,
                                 rcov = ~us(trait):units, #
                                 family= c("gaussian", "gaussian","gaussian"),
                                 prior =prior.1,
                                 verbose=TRUE, 
                                 nitt=103000,
                                 pr=TRUE,
                                 pl=TRUE,
                                 data=js.am.news.sc$imputations[[i]])
}



# Obtain summary results

# Anger
anger.combo.SOL<-mcmc.list(news.ang.m.mcmc.out[[1]]$Sol[,1:42], news.ang.m.mcmc.out[[2]]$Sol[,1:42],news.ang.m.mcmc.out[[3]]$Sol[,1:42],news.ang.m.mcmc.out[[4]]$Sol[,1:42],
news.ang.m.mcmc.out[[5]]$Sol[,1:42])

anger.combo.VCV<-mcmc.list(news.ang.m.mcmc.out[[1]]$VCV, news.ang.m.mcmc.out[[2]]$VCV,news.ang.m.mcmc.out[[3]]$VCV,news.ang.m.mcmc.out[[4]]$VCV,news.ang.m.mcmc.out[[5]]$VCV)
#saveRDS(anger.combo.VCV,"anger.combo.VCV")
summary(anger.combo.VCV)

news.wrm.m.mcmc.out<-readRDS("news.wrm.m.mcmc.out")

# Warmth
warm.combo.SOL<-mcmc.list(news.wrm.m.mcmc.out[[1]]$Sol,news.wrm.m.mcmc.out[[2]]$Sol, news.wrm.m.mcmc.out[[3]]$Sol,news.wrm.m.mcmc.out[[4]]$Sol,news.wrm.m.mcmc.out[[5]]$Sol)

warm.combo.VCV<- mcmc.list(news.wrm.m.mcmc.out[[1]]$VCV,news.wrm.m.mcmc.out[[2]]$VCV, news.wrm.m.mcmc.out[[3]]$VCV,news.wrm.m.mcmc.out[[4]]$VCV,news.wrm.m.mcmc.out[[5]]$VCV)


               
##############################################################################
####  Pairwise deleted set models  ####
##############################################################################


#Prior (parameter explanded priors)
prior.1= list(R = list(V = diag(3)*.002, nu=3.01),
                 G=list(G1=list(V=diag(3)*.02,nu=4, alpha.mu = rep(0,3), alpha.V = diag(3)*100),
                        G2=list(V=diag(3)*.02,nu=4, alpha.mu = rep(0,3), alpha.V = diag(3)*100)))



# Model for hostility
mod.1 <-MCMCglmm(cbind(T5.ETH.Anger.Arabs,T5.ETH.Anger.Asians,T5.ETH.Anger.Muslims) ~
                                   trait-1 +
                                   trait:Hours.News.T5.S *
                                   trait:Pol.Orient.T5.S +
                                   trait:RELID.T5.S +  
                                   trait:Age.T5.C + 
                                   trait:NZREG.T5.S  + 
                                   trait:Employed.T5 +
                                   trait:Euro.AnyTimePoint +
                                   trait:Gender.T5 + 
                                   trait:NZDep_2013.T05.S +
                                   trait:Parent.T5 +
                                   trait:Partner.T5 + 
                                   trait:Urban.T5,
                                 random= ~us(trait):Census.Religion.L3.T5 +
                   us(trait):Territorial.Authority.2013.T5,
                                 rcov = ~us(trait):units, #
                                 family= c("gaussian", "gaussian","gaussian"),
                                 prior =prior.1,
                                 verbose=TRUE, 
                                 nitt=103000,
                                 pr=TRUE,
                                 pl=TRUE,
                                 data=data.news)

summary(mod.1)

# Model for acceptance
mod.2 <-MCMCglmm(cbind(T5.ETH.Warm.Arabs,T5.ETH.Warm.Asians,T5.ETH.Warm.Muslims) ~
                                   trait-1 +
                                   trait:Hours.News.T5.S *
                                   trait:Pol.Orient.T5.S +
                                   trait:RELID.T5.S +  
                                   trait:Age.T5.C + 
                                   trait:NZREG.T5.S  + 
                                   trait:Employed.T5 +
                                   trait:Euro.AnyTimePoint +
                                   trait:Gender.T5 + 
                                   trait:NZDep_2013.T05.S +
                                   trait:Parent.T5 +
                                   trait:Partner.T5 + 
                                   trait:Urban.T5,
                                 random= ~us(trait):Census.Religion.L3.T5 +
                   us(trait):Territorial.Authority.2013.T5,
                                 rcov = ~us(trait):units, #
                                 family= c("gaussian", "gaussian","gaussian"),
                                 prior =prior.1,
                                 verbose=TRUE, 
                                 nitt=103000,
                                 pr=TRUE,
                                 pl=TRUE,
                                 data=data.news)
summary(mod.2)






```
